contractLead: Describe what you need in ordinary words. We parameterize a reviewed Solidity template (OpenZeppelin patterns). Gas is paid in PPL. Token/NFT factory remains the built-in path.

hub.title: No-code builder
hub.subtitle: Token, NFT, escrow, crowdfunding, plain-language contracts and Lavka — wizards that already exist on the public testnet.
hub.escrowLead: Sample escrow template: lock funds until a condition or deadline.
hub.crowdfundLead: Sample crowdfund template: set a goal and raise in PPL or a test stablecoin.
hub.lavkaLead: Loyalty passes and merchant escrow for local shops.

token.title: Create a token
token.lead: Standard Token Factory launch: name, ticker, supply, image, then pay the PPL fee.

nft.title: Create an NFT
nft.lead: Mint a unique item with a picture, name, and description. Optional collection name groups pieces.

form.imageHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Upload a file or paste a link to an image. You will see a preview first.
form.name: Name
form.feeUnset: Fee amount is unavailable because the configured value is invalid.
form.allocation: Standard launch split (fixed by the protocol): 60% curve, 10% community, 15% creator, 10% liquidity, 5% ecosystem.
form.success: The network accepted the signed transaction.
form.stableFeeBuybackNote: 100% of token and NFT launch fees (USDC/USDT) go to public PPL buybacks.
form.stableFeeNetworkNote: Works on the PEOPLE network only for now. Paying from another chain (Ethereum, Polygon, Tron, TON, Solana) is coming later.
form.leftoverHint: Choose what happens to tokens still on the bonding curve when it migrates to the AMM, or if the curve does not sell out within 180 days. Never to you (the creator) and never to the protocol treasury.
form.leftoverBurnHint: Default. Leftover and unsold tokens are permanently burned.
form.leftoverPoolHint: Send leftover and unsold tokens to this token's own community pool.
form.launchSummary: When you launch: 10% of supply goes to your token's community pool. You choose whether curve leftovers after AMM migration and unsold tokens at 180-day finalize are burned (default, recommended) or sent to that community pool — never to you or the treasury. Optional referral share: default 5% of supply (max 10%), invite bounty 5%.

tokenDescribe.title: Describe in your own words
tokenDescribe.lead: Optional helper: we suggest name, ticker, and supply from your description. You still review and sign the launch yourself.
tokenDescribe.placeholder: I want a token for my Telegram coffee channel, 1 million tokens so subscribers can support the channel.
tokenDescribe.reviewNote: This does not create a token or sign anything.
tokenDescribe.priceExplain: The protocol sets start price from virtual reserves: {{virtual}} PPL ÷ {{curve}} bonding-curve tokens at launch. You cannot pick a dollar price directly.
tokenDescribe.warnFundraising: No fundraising amount is guaranteed — only the bonding curve and market demand determine outcomes.
tokenDescribe.warnDollar: Dollar price is not configurable; we adjusted supply to fit the on-chain formula as closely as we can.
tokenDescribe.errorGeneric: Could not read that description. Try again or fill the fields manually.
tokenDescribe.errorRateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
tokenDescribe.errorTooShort: Add a bit more detail (at least a sentence).
tokenDescribe.nftLead: Optional helper: we suggest name, description, and collection mode. You still review and mint yourself.
tokenDescribe.nftPlaceholder: I want a membership pass NFT for my coffee club, one unique item, named Coffee Club Pass.
tokenDescribe.contractLead: Optional helper: we suggest a reviewed template and constructor values. You still compile, review, and deploy yourself.
tokenDescribe.contractPlaceholder: I need linear vesting of my token to a partner over one year.
tokenDescribe.discoverLead: Optional helper: we suggest title, idea, audience, and why-token copy. You still review and submit yourself.
tokenDescribe.discoverPlaceholder: A neighborhood rewards project for local shops using a community token.
tokenDescribe.lavkaLead: Optional helper: we suggest loyalty program title, visits, price, and validity. You still review and sign yourself.
tokenDescribe.lavkaPlaceholder: Coffee punch card, 10 visits, 5 PPL, valid 90 days, not transferable.
